comment: Signaling conformance vectors for LiquidServer (SIGNALING.md). Each step: [client text, expected server reply prefix or null for no reply]. answer_has applies to the last ANSWER.

vectors.name: browser_opus_call
steps:
OFFER:v=0
o=- 1 2 IN IP4 127.0.0.1
s=-
t=0 0
a=group:BUNDLE 0
m=audio 9 UDP/TLS/RTP/SAVPF 111 0 8 9 126
c=IN IP4 0.0.0.0
a=mid:0
a=sendrecv
a=rtcp-mux
a=setup:actpass
a=rtpmap:111 opus/48000/2
a=fmtp:111 minptime=10;useinbandfec=1
a=rtpmap:0 PCMU/8000
a=rtpmap:8 PCMA/8000
a=rtpmap:9 G722/8000
a=rtpmap:126 telephone-event/8000
